summary: Unified Probability Engine (iter 36) fully validated. All 24 pytest cases pass: /api/picks/{id}/probability returns the complete spec schema (p_v1, p_v2, sim_probability, p_final, p_calibrated, edge, classification, simulator_variance) + aux (stability_score, implied_probability, weights, calibration). Ensemble math is exact (0.30*v1+0.45*v2+0.25*sim → 0.595 for the canonical example). Edge clamped to [-0.15, +0.40] confirmed at both extremes. Classification rules (LOCK_99 / PREMIUM / CHALK / NORMAL) match spec including precedence (PREMIUM beats CHALK label). Bieber-style high-implied pick classifies PREMIUM with negative-but-clamped edge as expected. Static source-code invariants verified: zero v1/v2 subtractions in probability_engine.py and compute_edge is the ONLY edge-defining function in that module. /api/version returns the required data_version stamp '2026.06.23-unified-probability-engine'. Regression clean: /api/picks/today returns 100+ picks, legacy lock_score / edge_percent fields preserved on every pick, tennis edges non-zero, MLB pitcher_h2h still returns 10 rows with full keyset. 404 returned for unknown pick id. No code changes required.
critical_code_review_comments: probability_engine.py is 310 lines, well within the 700-line limit and cleanly layered (3 indep probabilities → ensemble → calibrate → edge → classify).
Engine is correctly additive — the endpoint reads the pick from DB read-only and returns a derived report; no mutation of stored lock_score / edge_percent.
ObjectId filter ({'_id': 0}) correctly applied in db.picks.find_one — no serialization risk.
All weights, thresholds, and clamps are module-level constants (W_V1/V2/SIM, EDGE_MIN/MAX, LOCK_99_*, PREMIUM_PROB, CHALK_IMPLIED) — easy to tune without touching logic.
implied_probability_from_odds defends against None / 0 odds (defaults to 0.5). Good.

Minor nit (non-blocking): unified_probability_report calls _calib_get_curve() three times per request (calibrate + 2x for the reported metadata). Could cache the curve handle locally; negligible perf impact since the curve object is already a process-level singleton.
seed_data_creation: None — used existing demo@lockscore.ai account and live /api/picks/today data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Reuse /app/backend/tests/test_probability_engine.py for any future regression on the Unified Probability Engine. Includes both HTTP (live pick) and pure-unit (deterministic math) coverage plus static-source-code invariants (no v1-v2 subtraction, single compute_edge function). If new edge-computing helpers are added to probability_engine.py, the test_compute_edge_is_only_edge_fn assertion will trip — update its allowlist intentionally.
